title: Keeping on top of life admin
summary: Keeps track of bills, renewals, appointments, deliveries and documents that expire, tells you the week ahead, and warns you before something is due.

asks.question: Which day suits you to deal with paperwork?
asks.why: So the week ahead comes on a day you can act on it.

senses.describe: Bills that arrive in your mailbox
senses.ask: If I watch your mailbox, bills and renewals get noted the day they arrive. Want to turn that on?
Shipping notices in your mailbox tell me what is on its way and when.
With your calendar connected I can remind you what to bring to appointments.

rhythms.do: The week ahead: bills due, renewals, appointments and deliveries expected, each with what to do about it.
Documents and subscriptions that expire or renew in the next 90 days, with how to renew each.
Note the bill; if it is due within five days, say so with the amount.

signals.when: a bill is due in the next three days and not paid
signals.say: Name it, the amount and the date.

check.sql: SELECT name, amount, currency, due FROM bills WHERE paid IS NULL AND due <= date('now', '+3 day') ORDER BY due

signals.when: a document expires in the next 60 days
signals.say: Name it, whose it is and when, and how it is renewed.

check.sql: SELECT name, holder, expires FROM documents WHERE expires <= date('now', '+60 day') ORDER BY expires

prepare.when: a confirmation names a date not on the calendar
prepare.describe: The appointment added to your calendar
